pages.text: $(#FF69B4)🌸 Four-Season Floral Decree · Banquet of Blossoms 🌼$()$(br2)$(l)$(#BA55D3)「When four flower spirits dance together, even mortals may temporarily attain a divine nature」$()$(br)The resilience of $(#BA55D3)hibiscus$(), the clarity of $(#D4AF37)honeysuckle$(), the passion of $(#8B0000)rose$(), and the tranquility of $(#9370DB)lavender$() merge within the $(#32CD32)Emerald Crucible$() to complete the $(l)ritual of seasonal cycles$()—the ultimate floral elixir capable of summoning $(l)the four aspects of nature$().

$(#FF69B4)▌ The Fourfold Floral Decree $()$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🦉 Owl’s Gaze$()$(br)Pupils reflect $(#000080)moonlight ripples$().$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🌪 Gale Step$()$(br)Petals of $(#98FB98)green breeze$() swirl around your feet.$(br2)$(l)$(#7CFC00)🍀 Lucky Storm$()$(br)Leaves a trail of $(#00FF00)glowing four-leaf clovers$().$(br2)$(l)$(#FF1493)💫 Floral Healing$()$(br)Wounds burst forth with $(#FF69B4)sakura-shaped$() healing light.

$(br2)$(#8B0000)▌ Floral Ritual $()$(br)- Use a $(#BA55D3)clean mortar$() to grind each dried flower into a $(#9370DB)coarse powder$().$(br)- Add $(#D4AF37)honeysuckle, rose, hibiscus, and lavender$() in order, following the $(#32CD32)east-south-west-north$() sequence.$(br)- Stir counterclockwise $(#FF69B4)seven times$(), then clockwise $(#4169E1)three times$().$(br)- Finish by filtering through a $(#00BFFF)fine sieve$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() A successful brew will form a $(#FF69B4)four-colored vortex$() with $(#7CFC00)luminous pollen$().

$(br2)$(#9370DB)『 Epic of the Flower Language 』$()$(br)An ancient druid text records:$(br)'When the $(#BA55D3)protection of hibiscus$(),$(br)the $(#D4AF37)purification of honeysuckle$(),$(br)the $(#8B0000)courage of the rose$(), and$(br)the $(#9370DB)foresight of lavender$()$(br)unite within the $(#32CD32)Emerald Crucible$(),$(br)the drinker shall receive:$()$(br)- $(#4169E1)The eyes of a nocturnal hunter$()$(br)- $(#32CD32)The swiftness of wind spirits$()$(br)- $(#7CFC00)The smile of Lady Luck$()$(br)- $(#FF69B4)The gentle touch of the Mother of Life$()$(br)However, they must return to the $(#98FB98)Nature Altar$() before the $(#FF1493)four-colored glow$() fades.'
